description: This file defines the Dispatcher class and related classes for managing SDK objects, event dispatching, and communication with the client in the Playwright core server. It handles object lifecycle, event propagation, command execution, and message dispatching within the Playwright infrastructure.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages SDK objects, event dispatching, and communication with the client, including object lifecycle, event propagation, and command execution.

classes.name: RootDispatcher
classes.description: Specialized Dispatcher for the root scope, initializes Playwright dispatcher.

classes.name: DispatcherConnection
classes.description: Handles message dispatching, object registration, and communication between server and client.

methods.name: setMaxDispatchersForTest
methods.description: Overrides maximum number of dispatchers for testing purposes.

methods.name: maxDispatchersForBucket
methods.description: Determines max dispatchers allowed per GC bucket.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, validates, executes commands, and sends responses.
